name: pointer constructor and inheritance
source: const e=new PointerEvent('pointerdown',{pointerId:7,pointerType:'touch',isPrimary:true,buttons:1,pressure:.5,width:8,height:6,clientX:13.25,clientY:8.5});record([e instanceof PointerEvent,e instanceof MouseEvent,e instanceof UIEvent,e instanceof Event,e.pointerId,e.pointerType,e.isPrimary,e.buttons,e.pressure,e.width,e.height,e.clientX,e.clientY,e.isTrusted].join('|'));

name: pointer integer conversion and finite coordinates
touch required members and brands
source: const a=document.getElementById('a');const t=new Touch({identifier:4294967297,target:a,clientX:12.5,pageY:13.75,force:.5});record([t instanceof Touch,t.identifier,t.target===a,t.clientX,t.pageY,t.radiusX,t.force,Object.prototype.toString.call(t)].join('|'));for(const init of [{},{identifier:1},{identifier:1,target:null},{identifier:1,target:{} }]){try{new Touch(init);record('accepted');}catch(e){record(e.name);}}

name: touch lists and sequence snapshots
source: const a=document.getElementById('a');const t=new Touch({identifier:1,target:a});const input=[t];const e=new TouchEvent('touchstart',{touches:input,targetTouches:input,changedTouches:input,ctrlKey:true});input.length=0;record([e instanceof UIEvent,e.touches instanceof TouchList,e.touches.length,e.touches[0]===t,e.touches.item(0)===t,e.touches.item(9)===null,e.touches[9]===undefined,[...e.touches][0]===t,e.ctrlKey,Object.keys(e.touches).join(',')].join('|'));try{new TouchList();record('accepted');}catch(e){record(e.name);}try{new TouchEvent('x',{touches:[{}]});record('accepted');}catch(e){record(e.name);}

name: touch and list readonly fields
source: const a=document.getElementById('a');const t=new Touch({identifier:1,target:a});const list=new TouchEvent('x',{touches:[t]}).touches;record([Reflect.set(t,'identifier',9),Reflect.set(t,'target',document),Reflect.set(list,'length',9),t.identifier,t.target===a,list.length].join('|'));for(const action of [()=>Touch({identifier:1,target:a}),()=>TouchEvent('x'),()=>Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Touch.prototype,'target').get.call({}),()=>TouchList.prototype.item.call({},0)]){try{action();record('accepted');}catch(e){record(e.name);}}

name: touch event cancellation and retained snapshot
synthetic composition and composing input
source: const a=document.getElementById('a');a.addEventListener('compositionstart',e=>record([e instanceof CompositionEvent,e instanceof UIEvent,e.data,e.isTrusted].join('|')),{once:true});a.onbeforeinput=e=>{record([e instanceof InputEvent,e.inputType,e.data,e.isComposing,e.getTargetRanges().length].join('|'));e.preventDefault();};a.dispatchEvent(new CompositionEvent('compositionstart',{bubbles:true,composed:true,data:'森'}));record(a.dispatchEvent(new InputEvent('beforeinput',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,composed:true,data:'森',inputType:'insertCompositionText',isComposing:true})));

name: touch dictionary getter order
source: const calls=[];const init={};for(const name of ['azimuthAngle','clientX','identifier','target','force','touchType'])Object.defineProperty(init,name,{get(){calls.push(name);return name==='target'?document:name==='touchType'?'direct':1;}});new Touch(init);record(calls.join('|'));

name: TouchList indexed operations
source: const a=document.getElementById('a'),t=new Touch({identifier:1,target:a});const l=new TouchEvent('x',{touches:[t]}).touches;for(const [name,fn]of [['set0',()=>Reflect.set(l,'0',null)],['set9',()=>Reflect.set(l,'9',t)],['define0null',()=>Reflect.defineProperty(l,'0',{value:null})],['define0write',()=>Reflect.defineProperty(l,'0',{writable:true})],['define0get',()=>Reflect.defineProperty(l,'0',{get(){return null;}})],['define9',()=>Reflect.defineProperty(l,'9',{value:t})],['delete9',()=>Reflect.deleteProperty(l,'9')],['strict0',()=>{(function(){'use strict';l[0]=null;})();return true;}],['strict9',()=>{(function(){'use strict';l[9]=t;})();return true;}]] ){try{record(name+':'+fn()+':'+(l[0]===t)+':'+(l[9]===undefined));}catch(e){record(name+':'+e.name);}}
